customManagers.description: Update any version that is annotated with a `# renovate:` comment on the preceding line (e.g. the pinned ESPHome release in the CI workflow and the setup script)

packageRules.description: The pinned ESPHome release lives in two files that must stay in sync, so update them in a single PR. ESPHome uses CalVer, so a new year is not a 'major' upgrade worth its own PR
